class.name: IfcDraughtingPreDefinedTextFont
class.brief_description: The draughting pre defined text font is a pre defined text font for the purpose to identify a font by name. Allowable names are: 'ISO 3098-1 font A', 'ISO 3098-1 font B', The ISO 3098-1 font A is the text font as denoted as Letterng A in clause 3 of ISO 3098-1, the ISO 3098-1 font B is the text font as denoted as Letterng B in clause 3 of ISO 3098-1.
